title: The Getzler-Gauss-Manin connection and Kontsevich-Soibelman operations on the periodic cyclic homology
summary: We study equivariant operations on the periodic cyclic homology of dg algebras that arise from the chain level action of the two-colored Kontsevich-Soibelman operad. The first main result is that these operations are covariantly constant with respect to the Getzler-Gauss-Manin connection on the periodic cyclic homology of a family of dg algebras. Then, using classical computations of Cohen \cite{Coh}, we explicitly compute a set of generators for these operations under composition, and show that these generators are closely related to the $p$-fold equivariant cap products previously studied…
